preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 1 and 300,000.
The number of queries m must be between 1 and 300,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n for x, y in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect valid vertices within the range of 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v_i <= n and 0 <= d_i <= 10**9 and 1 <= x_i <= 10**9 for v_i, d_i, x_i in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query must have valid vertex indices, distance, and value within specified bounds.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n integers, one for each vertex.
All output values must be non-negative integers.
At least one vertex must have a positive value after processing all queries.
